source.title: NYC OTI 3D Buildings Citywide
source.attribution: City of New York, OTI: 2014 surveyed 3D building geometry.
source.modifications: Spatial metadata indexed; I3S triangle surfaces streamed and projected into local meters. Ground height is flattened separately per feature for driving.
source.limitations: Historical untextured building survey; coarse levels simplify surveyed surfaces. Terrain elevation is flattened for gameplay.
